tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Brazilian companies by a term (`q`) and/or filters (`f`, a JSON string). `tipo` picks what the term matches: `nome` (legal name), `fantasia` (trade name), `socio` (partner), `telefone` (phone with area code), `email` (the full address on record), `endereco` (address) or `cnae` (activity code)

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Up to eight Brazilian companies for a CNPJ, name, partner, phone or e-mail. It detects the kind of input, joins the names and removes duplicates. tools.name: list_watches

tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Starts watching a CNPJ. The first one is free; each extra slot is paid per 30 days, with no automatic renewal (the price is in `x-price-usd` and in `/api/pricing`). findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_connections, search, consulta_lote · Private data: find_similar_companies, get_company_connections, get_digital_presence, get_cnpj, reveal_cnpj, sintonia_seal, dossier_cnpj, search, suggest, consulta_lote, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: get_company_connections, search, consulta_lote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_connections, search, consulta_lote · Private data: find_similar_companies, get_company_connections, get_digital_presence, get_cnpj, reveal_cnpj, sintonia_seal, dossier_cnpj, search, suggest, consulta_lote, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: get_company_connections, search, consulta_lote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.detail: Tool "list_watches" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "The CNPJs you watch, with the applied quota (free + purchased slots).
The origin (`api.radar-cnpj.com`) checks the quota, inside the transaction; the app counts one free slot plus the purchased slots in force. A watch over the quota comes with `suspensa: true` and sends no e-mail." → after: "List your company's and search watches with shared capacity: one free company, one free search and any valid paid slots. Includes paused items and exact saved-search criteria."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
